title: 第9章 俯卧撑第10章 再起杀心
slug: 给你玉女心经没让你用双修证道
content_zh:
从树上跳下来，黄夜心情很愉悦，美滋滋地回了屋子。
“少爷的样子好像捡了钱袋子一样，什么事儿这么高兴？”晴儿不解的问道。
“哈哈，我刚才在院子里试了一下弹跳力，发现竟然能跳五米高，简直是奇迹。”
“少爷，五米是什么意思？”晴儿问道。
小丫头感觉很奇怪，少爷这次苏醒之后好像变化很大，今天又弄出个五米。
黄夜也知道自己说走嘴了，自己并不清楚这里如何计算长度，不过这丫头是自己人，出现这种小失误也没事儿。
有她在，自己犯错的时候，反倒多了一层保护伞，不过自己在实力弱小的时候，还是要注意这方面。
自己也要想好一旦说漏嘴，找补的方法。
按这里的信息交流方式，局限性肯定很大。
想当年秦始皇统一度量衡也仅做到辖区内，自己买一双鞋还有欧标和国标。
遇到不熟悉的人，自己可以推脱来自其它地方。
想到这里，黄夜已经释然，开口解释道。
“比我们这个屋子的棚顶高点。”
“少爷，棚顶好像不高吧。”晴儿看看屋顶。
“怎么不高，我小时候连一米跳不到。”
“少爷，如果棚顶有五米高，府中那些侍卫应该能跳十米。”
黄夜一愣，一张脸立刻垮下来，这丫头打击人的方式貌似很温柔。
这货忘了，自己不是在前世，不能拿现在的成绩跟前世相比。
自己这个弹跳力比凡人高，可是对比那些修炼过的武者，还是弱爆了。
不行，必须加强训练，连侍卫都轻松虐自己，就算自己想跑，侍卫也能轻松抓住自己。

从今天开始，先用传统方法练习体能。
想想前世各种体能练习的方法，这货第一个选的是俯卧撑。
连续做了五十个，没什么感觉。
前世做三十个，自己就趴趴了，去去去，怎么又和前世对比。
换成单手俯卧撑，还是没什么感觉。
“晴儿，你趴到我身上！”
晴儿一愣，刚才这丫头便觉得少爷的动作很奇怪。
现在少爷让自己趴到他身上干什么？难道少爷想在地上做那羞羞的事儿？
脑补一下画面，小丫头脸红了。
晴儿走过来，等着黄夜翻身，结果这家伙还是刚才的姿势。
“少爷，你要翻过来才行。”
黄夜一愣，转过去怎么做俯卧撑！
猛地一怔，“晴儿，我这是在锻炼身体，你趴在后背抱住我就行。”
晴儿的脸顿时变成一块红布，这家伙，真是坑娘！
小丫头老实地趴在黄夜后背，紧紧抱住黄夜，胸口都变形了。
黄夜心潮澎湃，赶紧做起俯卧撑，一百斤的分量加上去，效果好多了。
content_en:
Huang Ye jumped down from the tree and returned to the house happily.
"The young master looks like he has picked up a money bag. Why are you so happy?" Qing'er asked in confusion.
"Haha, I just tried my jumping ability in the yard and found that I can jump five meters high. It's a miracle."
"Master, what does five meters mean?" Qing'er asked.
The little girl felt very strange. The young master seemed to have changed a lot after waking up this time. Today he was five meters taller again.
Huang Ye also knew that he was lying. He didn't know how to calculate the length here, but this girl was one of her own, so it was okay to make such a small mistake.
With her here, I have an extra layer of protection when I make mistakes, but I still have to pay attention to this aspect when I am weak.
You should also think of ways to make amends if you slip up.
The way information is exchanged here is definitely very limited.
I think that when Qin Shihuang unified weights and measures, he could only do it within his jurisdiction. When you buy a pair of shoes, you still have European and national standards.
When you meet someone you are not familiar with, you can deduce that you are from somewhere else.
Thinking of this, Huang Ye was relieved and opened his mouth to explain.
"It's higher than the roof of our house."
"Master, it seems that the roof of the shed is not high." Qing'er looked at the roof.
"Why isn't it high? I couldn't even jump one meter when I was a kid."
"Master, if the roof of the shed is five meters high, the guards in the mansion should be able to jump ten meters."
Huang Ye was stunned, and his face immediately fell. The way this girl hit people seemed to be very gentle.
This guy has forgotten that he is not in his previous life, so he cannot compare his current achievements with his previous life.
My jumping ability is higher than that of ordinary people, but compared to those warriors who have practiced, I am still weak.
No, you must strengthen your training. Even the guards can easily abuse you. Even if you want to run away, the guards can easily catch you.
Start today by practicing physical fitness the traditional way.
Thinking about various physical training methods in previous lives, the first thing this guy chose was push-ups.
I did fifty times in a row and felt nothing.
I did thirty in my previous life, and then I just fell asleep and kept going. How could I compare it with my previous life?
Switching to one-handed push-ups, I still feel nothing.
"Qing'er, lie on top of me!"
Qing'er was stunned. Just now, this girl felt that the young master's actions were strange.
Why did the young master let himself lie on top of him now? Does the young master want to do that shameful thing on the ground?
The little girl blushed as she imagined the scene in her mind.
Qing'er came over and waited for Huang Ye to turn over, but the guy was still in the same posture as before.
"Master, you have to turn over."
Huang Ye was stunned and turned around to do push-ups!
Suddenly startled, "Qing'er, I'm exercising, just lie down on your back and hug me."
Qing'er's face suddenly turned into a red cloth, this guy is really cheating!
The little girl lay obediently on Huang Ye's back and hugged Huang Ye so tightly that her chest was deformed.
Huang Ye's heart was racing and he quickly started doing push-ups. With the addition of a hundred kilograms of weight, the effect was much better.
